content.summary: The main contribution is framed responsibly: the manuscript distinguishes a smaller finite proof target from an extremal improvement, distinguishes a local unresolved input from the literature result, and separates mathematical arguments from partial formal coverage. I verified the inspected manuscript digest. The principal definitions and two displayed universal inequalities agree with the inspected Lean interfaces. One formal-assurance claim lacks a traceable source and receipt in the frozen evidence; this should be repaired before publication.
required_revisions: For FrontierPairSix.common_point_of_incidence_defect, add its actual source and successful receipt to prospective frozen evidence, or remove/qualify the claim that it is fully elaborated.

findings.statement: The local six-codegree section calls FrontierPairSix.common_point_of_incidence_defect fully elaborated, but the E01–E18 inventory supplies no identifiable PairSix source or compiler receipt. The mathematical explanation is readable; the separate formal-assurance assertion is not auditable from this snapshot.
findings.disposition: Supply evidence or qualify the formal status; do not infer it from unrelated successful roots.

findings.statement: The support-56 and nine-triple results are unnumbered statements, whereas the earlier inequalities are Theorems 1 and 2. Stable theorem labels would make the coverage discussion and future proof references easier to follow.
findings.disposition: Number the main mathematical results consistently and refer to those labels in the coverage paragraph.

checks.scope: Definitions and assumptions of Theorem 1 and Corollary 1
checks.method: Compared displayed hypotheses and endpoint convention with E01 theorem declarations and E02 printed-root receipt.
checks.observation: Finite distinct members, uniform rank, reflexive intersection, arbitrary universe, and degree bound align. The r=0 qualification correctly explains natural subtraction; 19n+868<=2240 supports n<=72.

checks.method: Read E05 three_star_second_moment signature against the prose statement.
checks.observation: All three distinctness assumptions, uniformity, reflexive intersection, integer casts, and the negative triple-codegree term are disclosed; no sunflower hypothesis has been silently imported.
